source: Local text styles + the Typography variable collection in the Semio UI Library. FOUNDATION: a code-aligned type ramp mirroring @semio/ui's text sizing — the `sized-text` component scale (0.6rem/xs/base/xl/2xl) plus the common `text-sm`, with Tailwind-default line-heights. Font is Inter, the deliberate proxy for the code's system-sans stack (--font-sans: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, …); typography/font-family variable = Inter. Weighted styles cover the real font-medium/semibold usage. Specimen at 639:897. Refresh from the live file before CI.
